sections.what_happened: From 18:00 Oct 23 overnight: Russia attacked with 126 strike drones -- 61 jet-powered Shaheds plus S8000 Banderol/Dan-T cruise-missile drones, Gerbera and Parodiya decoys -- launched from Shatalovo, Oryol, Bryansk, Kursk, Primorsko-Akhtarsk, occupied Donetsk, Hvardiiske (Crimea) and the Sea of Azov. As of 08:00 Oct 24 (Kyiv): air defences destroyed/jammed 101 (50 jet-powered Shaheds); hits recorded at 14 locations, debris falls at 5; 8 drones still airborne, combat ongoing. Separately, Zelensky (Hudson Institute, Friday): Starlink slowdown blamed on the US 'has still not been fully restored' despite Secretary Rubio assuring unlimited speeds within 48-72 hours; slower speeds make intercepting Russian projectiles harder. White House (Friday, via Bloomberg): Russia and Ukraine agreed Oleshky aid/evacuation arrangement -- see 1300-05 for the date clarification.
sections.what_verified: Ukrainian Air Force primary statement carried by Ukrinform (T2, state UA) and Ukrainska Pravda/LB.ua (same primary family, counted once via Air Force); Bloomberg (T1) for the Zelensky/Starlink and White House Oleshky lines via Hindu BusinessLine. Drone counts are single-primary-source (Ukrainian Air Force) -- Russian side has not confirmed; label held at ATTRIBUTED REPORT for counts, VERIFIED FACT for the fact of the Air Force statement.
sections.what_disputed: No Russian confirmation of the barrage in-window; Ukrainian loss/attrition claims (RBC-Ukraine: +1,980 Russian troops Oct 23) are Ukrainian Defence Ministry estimates, not independently verified, and are NOT adopted here. ISW (via RBC): Russian advance averaging 0.25 sq km/day this year, net -241 sq km since Sep 1 -- context, not verification of tonight's strikes.
sections.why_matters: 126 drones in one night -- 61 of them jet-powered -- while the Starlink speeds Ukraine's interceptors depend on are still throttled. Kyiv blames Washington; Washington promised a fix days ago.
sections.context: Background: NEW to scans (big-missed overnight) -- Russia launched 126 drones at Ukraine overnight Oct 23-24 (61 jet-powered Shaheds); Ukraine says 101 neutralised, strikes at 14 locations; Zelensky: Starlink speeds STILL not restored despite Rubio 48-72h assurance

totw_analysis: Our read: 126 drones in one night -- 61 of them jet-powered -- while the Starlink speeds Ukraine's interceptors depend on are still throttled. Kyiv blames Washington; Washington promised a fix days ago. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Jet-powered drone swarms vs throttled Starlink: is Kyiv losing the interception race because of Moscow's new drones, or because Washington slowed the network its defences run on?
